title: First voice download after high school: 'reality is subjective'

tellings.quote: The first one that I ever got was I was just out of high school and it didn't make any sense to me, which is was the voice was reality is subjective.

plain: A man named Brent Friedman, a guest on an episode about Hollywood, the CIA and UFOs, says that just out of high school he heard a voice deliver a message to him, the first of what he calls downloads, and it said "reality is subjective." He tells Michels it made no sense to him at the time. He tells it as the start of a lifelong run of such messages.
